Package Weng.CodeGen

Class Summary
AddrFmt  
AddrFmtTestData  
Clfile A Clfile object provides access to the cutter-location and and supporting data required to generate CNC code for a machine tool.
CodeGen Use this singleton class to generate a CNC code file.
DimAddr An object of the class DimAddr is used to represent a machine register that tracks dimensional information, such as tool position.
Group Use a Group object to manage the relationship between Symbol objects.
MiscAddr An object of the class MiscAddr is used to represent a machine register that tracks non-dimensional information, such as feedrates and spindle speeds.
ProgNum Uset this singleton object to manage program numbers.
QuadIter An object of the class QuadIter (quadrant iterator) is typically used when generating arc output for machines tools that are restricted to processing arc quadrant data.
SafeZone  
SemiIter An object of the class SemiIter (semi-circle iterator) is typically used when generating arc output for machines tools that are restricted to processing arc semi-circle (180 degree max.) data.
Symbol Use an object of class Symbol to represent miscellaneous and preparatory function codes, such as G01 and M00.
